svg.aria-label: The disk file now holds its fixed regions, blocks the filesystem uses, blocks it freed that are still stored, and space no block holds any more. After a trim and a compaction only the regions and the blocks in use remain. wsl-shrinker reads the block table and the filesystem's bitmaps to count each part.
